# SquashFS Profile Fixture

`qualification-base-v1.squashfs` is a real image generated by squashfs-tools
4.6.1. It contains only `squashfs-root/marker.txt`, not a runnable systemd base.
It independently anchors the on-disk flags used by qualification admission.

Regenerate from this directory, with an absent output path:

```sh
mksquashfs squashfs-root qualification-base-v1.squashfs \
  -noappend -all-root -no-xattrs -no-progress -no-exports \
  -comp zstd -b 131072 -processors 1 -reproducible \
  -mkfs-time 1700000000 -all-time 1700000000
```

SquashFS's `NO_XATTR` is bit 9 (`0x0200`); bit 8 means uncompressed xattrs,
not absent xattrs. See the [4.6.1 format definition](https://github.com/plougher/squashfs-tools/blob/4.6.1/squashfs-tools/squashfs_fs.h#L57-L108).
